marcar_suministro.title: Mark where the supply for {contrato} is to see the water analysis

ubicacion.title: Water analysis for {contrato}
ubicacion.description:
The EMASESA integration can now show your **tap water analysis** (chlorine, hardness, pH, conductivity…) from the data EMASESA reports to the Spanish Ministry of Health.

The analysis is different in each municipality, so it needs to know **where this supply is**. Mark the point on the map: your Home Assistant location is preset, but move it if the contract is for another home. The point never leaves your Home Assistant.
